!paypalId.test(input.orderId) || typeof input.url !== 'string') return json({ error: 'Invalid PayPal order' }, 400)\n        const url = new URL(input.url)\n        if (url.protocol !== 'https:' || !['www.paypal.com', 'www.sandbox.paypal.com'].includes(url.hostname) || url.port || url.username || url.password || url.pathname !== '/checkoutnow' || url.searchParams.get('token') !== input.orderId) return json({ error: 'Invalid PayPal checkout address' }, 400)\n        return json(await storage.transaction(async storage => {\n          const previous = await storage.get<PayPalCheckout | null>('paypal:checkout')\n          if (!previous || previous.id !== input.id || (previous.orderId && previous.orderId !== input.orderId)) return { saved: false }\n          const historical = await storage.get<{ id: string }>(`paypal:order:${input.orderId}`)\n          if (historical && historical.id !== input.id) return { saved: false }\n          await storage.put(`paypal:order:${input.orderId}`, { id: input.id })\n          await storage.put('paypal:checkout', { ...previous, orderId: input.orderId, url: input.url })\n          return { saved: true }\n        }))\n      }\n      if (path === '/paypal-get') {\n        if (typeof input.orderId !== 'string' || !paypalId.test(input.orderId)) return json({ error: 'Invalid PayPal order' }, 400)\n        const owned = await storage.get<{ id: string }>(`paypal:order:${input.orderId}`)\n        return json(owned ? { owned: true, id: owned.id } : { owned: false })\n      }\n      if (path === '/paypal-clear') {\n        if (typeof input.id !== 'string' || !ACCOUNT_ID.test(input.id)) return json({ error: 'Invalid PayPal checkout' }, 400)\n        return json(await storage.transaction(async storage => {\n          const previous = await storage.get<PayPalCheckout | null>('paypal:checkout')\n          if (!previous || previous.id !== input.id) return { cleared: false }\n          await storage.put('paypal:checkout', null)\n          return { cleared: true }\n        }))\n      }\n      if (path === '/checkout-reserve') {\n        if (!['subscription', 'topup'].includes(String(input.kind))) return json({ error: 'Invalid checkout' }, 400)\n        const kind = input.kind as string\n        const plan: PlanId | undefined = kind === 'subscription' ? (['creator', 'pro', 'studio'].includes(String(input.plan)) ? input.plan as PlanId : 'creator') : undefined\n        return json(await storage.transaction(async storage => {\n          const previous = await storage.get<Checkout>(`checkout:${kind}`)\n          const previousPlan = previous?.plan ?? (kind === 'subscription' ? 'creator' : undefined)\n          if (previous && previousPlan === plan && (previous.expiresAt ?? previous.created + DAY) > now) return { ...previous, ...(previousPlan ? { plan: previousPlan } : {}), repeated: true }\n          const value: Checkout = { id: crypto.randomUUID(), created: now, ...(plan ? { plan } : {}) }\n          await storage.put(`checkout:${kind}`, value)\n          return { ...value, repeated: false }\n        }))\n      }\n      if (path === '/checkout-finish') {\n        if (!['subscription', 'topup'].includes(String(input.kind)) || typeof input.id !== 'string' || typeof input.url !== 'string' || !/^https:\\/\\/checkout\\.stripe\\.com\\//.test(input.url) || !validInteger(input.expiresAt) || (input.expiresAt as number) <= now || typeof input.sessionId !== 'string' || !/^cs_[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,180}$/.test(input.sessionId)) return json({ error: 'Invalid checkout' }, 400)\n        const plan: PlanId | undefined = input.kind === 'subscription' ? (['creator', 'pro', 'studio'].includes(String(input.plan)) ? input.plan as PlanId : 'creator') : undefined\n        return json(await storage.transaction(async storage => {\n          const previous = await storage.get<Checkout>(`checkout:${input.kind}`)\n          const previousPlan = previous?.plan ?? (input.kind === 'subscription' ? 'creator' : undefined)\n          if (!previous || previous.id !== input.id || previousPlan !== plan) return { saved: false }\n          await storage.put(`checkout:${input.kind}`, { ...previous, url: input.url, expiresAt: input.expiresAt, sessionId: input.sessionId }); return { saved: true }\n        }))\n      }\n      if (path === '/checkout-clear') {\n        if (!['subscription', 'topup'].includes(String(input.kind)) || typeof input.id !== 'string') return json({ error: 'Invalid checkout' }, 400)\n        return json(await storage.transaction(async storage => {\n          const previous = await storage.get<Checkout>(`checkout:${input.kind}`)\n          if (!previous || previous.id !== input.id) return { cleared: false }\n          await storage.put(`checkout:${input.kind}`, { ...previous, created: 0, expiresAt: 0 }); return { cleared: true }\n        }))\n      }\n      return json({ error: 'Not found' }, 404)\n    } catch { return json({ error: 'Account allowance unavailable' }, 503) }\n  }\n}\n\n/** This helper is server-only. Never accept a uid from a request parameter or body. */\ntype SupportContext = { identity?: AstraSupportIdentity; available?: boolean; consumed?: boolean; approvalId?: string; statusKnown?: boolean;\n  supplemental?: { available?: boolean; consumed?: boolean; statusKnown?: boolean; claim?: AstraSupplementalClaim };\n  repaired?: { available?: boolean; consumed?: boolean; statusKnown?: boolean; claim?: AstraRepairedMccClaim };\n  project?: { selected?: boolean; available?: boolean; committed?: boolean; statusKnown?: boolean; record?: AstraProjectBudgetRecord } }\nfunction internalHeaders(userId: string, support?: SupportContext) {\n  return { 'X-WORLDIFACT-Verified-Account': userId.toLowerCase(),\n    ...(support?.identity?.emailVerified === true ? { 'X-WORLDIFACT-Verified-Email': support.identity.email.toLowerCase() } : {}),\n    ...(support?.statusKnown === true ? { 'X-WORLDIFACT-Support-Status': 'known' } : {}),\n    ...(support?.available === true ? { 'X-WORLDIFACT-Support-Available': 'true' } : {}),\n    ...(support?.consumed === true ? { 'X-WORLDIFACT-Support-Consumed': 'true' } : {}),\n    ...(support?.approvalId ? { 'X-WORLDIFACT-Support-Approval': support.approvalId } : {}),\n    ...(support?.supplemental?.statusKnown === true ? { 'X-WORLDIFACT-Supplemental-Status': 'known' } : {}),\n    ...(support?.supplemental?.available === true ? { 'X-WORLDIFACT-Supplemental-Available': 'true' } : {}),\n    ...(support?.supplemental?.consumed === true ? { 'X-WORLDIFACT-Supplemental-Consumed': 'true' } : {}),\n    ...(support?.supplemental?.claim ? { 'X-WORLDIFACT-Supplemental-Claim': JSON.stringify(support.supplemental.claim) } : {}),\n    ...(support?.repaired?.statusKnown === true ? { 'X-WORLDIFACT-Repaired-Mcc-Status': 'known' } : {}),\n    ...(support?.repaired?.available === true ? { 'X-WORLDIFACT-Repaired-Mcc-Available': 'true' } : {}),\n    ...(support?.repaired?.consumed === true ? { 'X-WORLDIFACT-Repaired-Mcc-Consumed': 'true' } : {}),\n    ...(support?.repaired?.claim ? { 'X-WORLDIFACT-Repaired-Mcc-Claim': JSON.stringify(support.repaired.claim) } : {}),\n    ...(support?.project?.selected === true ? { 'X-WORLDIFACT-Project-Budget-Selected': 'true' } : {}),\n    ...(support?.project?.statusKnown === true ? { 'X-WORLDIFACT-Project-Budget-Status': 'known' } : {}),\n    ...(support?.project?.available === true ? { 'X-WORLDIFACT-Project-Budget-Available': 'true' } : {}),\n    ...(support?.project?.committed === true ? { 'X-WORLDIFACT-Project-Budget-Committed': 'true' } : {}),\n    ...(support?.project?.record ? { 'X-WORLDIFACT-Project-Budget-Record': JSON.stringify(support.project.record) } : {}) }\n}\nexport async function entitlementCall<T>(env: EntitlementEnv, userId: string, path: string, body?: unknown, support?: SupportContext): Promise<T> {\n  if (!ACCOUNT_ID.test(userId)) throw new EntitlementError('A verified account is required.', 401)\n  if (!env.ACCOUNT_ENTITLEMENTS) throw new EntitlementError('Account allowances are not configured.')\n  if (env.ACCOUNT_LEDGER_MODE !== undefined && !['sandbox', 'live'].includes(env.ACCOUNT_LEDGER_MODE)) throw new EntitlementError('Account ledger mode is invalid.')\n  // Sandbox balances, customers, captures and subscriptions can never become live\n  // simply by switching provider API credentials. Preserve existing live IDs.\n  const prefix = env.ACCOUNT_LEDGER_MODE === 'sandbox' ? 'account:sandbox:v1' : 'account:v1'\n  const object = env.ACCOUNT_ENTITLEMENTS.get(env.ACCOUNT_ENTITLEMENTS.idFromName(`${prefix}:${userId.toLowerCase()}`))\n  let response: Response\n  try { response = await object.fetch(new Request(`https://entitlements.internal${generationPath(path) ? PAID_POINTS_ROUTE_PREFIX : ''}${path}`, { method: body === undefined ? 'GET' : 'POST', headers: internalHeaders(userId, support), ...(body === undefined ? {} : { body: JSON.stringify(body) }), signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000) })) }\n  catch { throw new EntitlementError('Account allowances are temporarily unavailable.') }\n  if (!response.ok && !(['/reserve', '/reserve-overnight-test'].includes(path) && response.status === 429)) throw new EntitlementError('Account allowances are temporarily unavailable.')\n  return response.json() as Promise<T>\n}\nasync function supportCall(env: EntitlementEnv, userId: string, identity?: AstraSupportIdentity, body?: { id: string; fingerprint: string }): Promise<{ available?: boolean; consumed?: boolean; approved?: boolean; approvalId?: string }> {\n  if (!env.WORLDIFACT_ASTRA_SUPPORT_ONCE || (env.ACCOUNT_LEDGER_MODE !== undefined && env.ACCOUNT_LEDGER_MODE !== 'live')) return {}\n  if (!ACCOUNT_ID.test(userId) || !env.ACCOUNT_ENTITLEMENTS) throw new EntitlementError('A verified account allowance is required.')\n  const object = env.ACCOUNT_ENTITLEMENTS.get(env.ACCOUNT_ENTITLEMENTS.idFromName(ASTRA_SUPPORT_NAMESPACE))\n  try {\n    const response = await object.fetch(new Request(`https://entitlements.internal/astra-support-${body ? 'claim' : 'status'}`, {\n      method: body ? 'POST' : 'GET', headers: internalHeaders(userId, { identity }), ...(body ? { body: JSON.stringify(body) } : {}), signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000),\n    }))\n    if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Unconfirmed support state')\n    const result = await response.json() as Record<string, unknown>\n    if (!result || typeof result !== 'object' || (body ? typeof result.approved !== 'boolean' || (result.approved && (typeof result.approvalId !== 'string' || !ACCOUNT_ID.test(result.approvalId)))\n      : typeof result.available !== 'boolean' || typeof result.consumed !== 'boolean')) throw new Error('Invalid support state')\n    return body ? { approved: result.approved === true, ...(result.approved ? { approvalId: String(result.approvalId) } : {}) } : { available: result.available === true, consumed: result.consumed === true }\n  } catch { throw new EntitlementError('The one-time support allowance could not be confirmed. Keep the same job; do not start another.') }\n}\nasync function supplementalCall(env: EntitlementEnv, userId: string, identity?: AstraSupportIdentity, body?: { id: string; fingerprint: string }): Promise<{ available?: boolean; consumed?: boolean; claim?: AstraSupplementalClaim }> {\n  if (!env.WORLDIFACT_ASTRA_SUPPLEMENTAL_GRANT || (env.ACCOUNT_LEDGER_MODE !== undefined && env.ACCOUNT_LEDGER_MODE !== 'live')) return {}\n  if (!ACCOUNT_ID.test(userId) || !env.ACCOUNT_ENTITLEMENTS) throw new EntitlementError('A verified account allowance is required.')\n  const configuration = env.WORLDIFACT_ASTRA_SUPPLEMENTAL_GRANT\n  const object = env.ACCOUNT_ENTITLEMENTS.get(env.ACCOUNT_ENTITLEMENTS.idFromName(ASTRA_SUPPLEMENTAL_NAMESPACE))\n  try {\n    const response = await object.fetch(new Request(`https://entitlements.internal/astra-supplemental-${body ? 'claim' : 'status'}`, {\n      method: body ? 'POST' : 'GET', headers: internalHeaders(userId, { identity }), ...(body ? { body: JSON.stringify(body) } : {}), signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000),\n    }))\n    if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Unconfirmed supplemental state')\n    const result = await response.json() as Record<string, unknown>\n    if (!result || typeof result !== 'object' || Array.isArray(result)) throw new Error('Invalid supplemental state')\n    if (!body) {\n      if (Object.keys(result).length !== 2 || typeof result.available !== 'boolean' || typeof result.consumed !== 'boolean' || (result.available && result.consumed)) throw new Error('Invalid supplemental status')\n      return { available: result.available, consumed: result.consumed }\n    }\n    if (result.approved === false && Object.keys(result).length === 1) return {}\n    const claim = result.claim as AstraSupplementalClaim | undefined\n    const approved = astraSupplementalGrant(configuration, userId, env.ACCOUNT_LEDGER_MODE, claim?.at as number, identity?.emailVerified === true ? identity.email : null)\n    if (result.approved !== true || Object.keys(result).length !== 2 || !approved || !matchesAstraSupplementalClaim(claim, approved, claim?.at as number, body.id, body.fingerprint)) throw new Error('Invalid supplemental claim')\n    // Account admission independently rechecks this complete original claim\n    // against its current configuration and clock before making any hold.\n    return { claim }\n  } catch { throw new EntitlementError('The supplemental support allowance could not be confirmed. Keep the same job; do not start another.') }\n}\nasync function repairedMccCall(env: EntitlementEnv, userId: string, identity?: AstraSupportIdentity, body?: { id: string; fingerprint: string }): Promise<{ available?: boolean; consumed?: boolean; claim?: AstraRepairedMccClaim }> {\n  if (!env.WORLDIFACT_ASTRA_REPAIRED_MCC_GRANT || (env.ACCOUNT_LEDGER_MODE !== undefined && env.ACCOUNT_LEDGER_MODE !== 'live')) return {}\n  if (!ACCOUNT_ID.test(userId) || !env.ACCOUNT_ENTITLEMENTS) throw new EntitlementError('A verified account allowance is required.')\n  const configuration = env.WORLDIFACT_ASTRA_REPAIRED_MCC_GRANT\n  const object = env.ACCOUNT_ENTITLEMENTS.get(env.ACCOUNT_ENTITLEMENTS.idFromName(ASTRA_REPAIRED_MCC_NAMESPACE))\n  try {\n    const response = await object.fetch(new Request(`https://entitlements.internal/astra-repaired-mcc-${body ? 'claim' : 'status'}`, {\n      method: body ? 'POST' : 'GET', headers: internalHeaders(userId, { identity }), ...(body ? { body: JSON.stringify(body) } : {}), signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000),\n    }))\n    if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Unconfirmed repaired MCC state')\n    const result = await response.json() as Record<string, unknown>\n    if (!result || typeof result !== 'object' || Array.isArray(result)) throw new Error('Invalid repaired MCC state')\n    if (!body) {\n      if (Object.keys(result).length !== 2 || typeof result.available !== 'boolean' || typeof result.consumed !== 'boolean' || (result.available && result.consumed)) throw new Error('Invalid repaired MCC status')\n      return { available: result.available, consumed: result.consumed }\n    }\n    if (result.approved === false && Object.keys(result).length === 1) return {}\n    const claim = result.claim as AstraRepairedMccClaim | undefined\n    const approved = astraRepairedMccGrant(configuration, userId, env.ACCOUNT_LEDGER_MODE, claim?.at as number, identity?.emailVerified === true ? identity.email : null)\n    if (result.approved !== true || Object.keys(result).length !== 2 || !approved || !matchesAstraRepairedMccClaim(claim, approved, claim?.at as number, body.id, body.fingerprint)) throw new Error('Invalid repaired MCC claim')\n    return { claim }\n  } catch { throw new EntitlementError('The repaired MCC allowance could not be confirmed. Keep the same job; do not start another.') }\n}\nasync function projectBudgetSelected(env: EntitlementEnv, userId: string, fingerprint: string): Promise<boolean> {\n  if (!ACCOUNT_ID.test(userId) || !env.ACCOUNT_ENTITLEMENTS) throw new EntitlementError('A verified account allowance is required.')\n  if (env.ACCOUNT_LEDGER_MODE === 'sandbox') return false\n  const object = env.ACCOUNT_ENTITLEMENTS.get(env.ACCOUNT_ENTITLEMENTS.idFromName(ASTRA_PROJECT_BUDGET_NAMESPACE))\n  try {\n    const response = await object.fetch(new Request('https://entitlements.internal/astra-project-budget-route', {\n      headers: { ...internalHeaders(userId), 'X-WORLDIFACT-Project-Fingerprint': fingerprint }, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000),\n    }))\n    if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Unconfirmed project source')\n    const result = await response.json() as Record<string, unknown>\n    if (!result || typeof result !== 'object' || Array.isArray(result) || Object.keys(result).length !== 1 || typeof result.selected !== 'boolean') throw new Error('Invalid project source')\n    return result.selected\n  } catch { throw new EntitlementError('The project funding source could not be confirmed. Keep the same job; do not start another.') }\n}\nasync function projectBudgetCall(env: EntitlementEnv, userId: string, body?: { id: string; fingerprint: string }): Promise<{ available?: boolean; committed?: boolean; record?: AstraProjectBudgetRecord }> {\n  if (!env.WORLDIFACT_ASTRA_PROJECT_BUDGET || (env.ACCOUNT_LEDGER_MODE !== undefined && env.ACCOUNT_LEDGER_MODE !== 'live')) return {}\n  if (!ACCOUNT_ID.test(userId) || !env.ACCOUNT_ENTITLEMENTS) throw new EntitlementError('A verified account allowance is required.')\n  const configuration = env.WORLDIFACT_ASTRA_PROJECT_BUDGET\n  const object = env.ACCOUNT_ENTITLEMENTS.get(env.ACCOUNT_ENTITLEMENTS.idFromName(ASTRA_PROJECT_BUDGET_NAMESPACE))\n  try {\n    const response = await object.fetch(new Request(`https://entitlements.internal/astra-project-budget-${body ? 'claim' : 'status'}`, {\n      method: body ? 'POST' : 'GET', headers: internalHeaders(userId), ...(body ? { body: JSON.stringify(body) } : {}), signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000),\n    }))\n    if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Unconfirmed project budget')\n    const result = await response.json() as Record<string, unknown>\n    if (!result || typeof result !== 'object' || Array.isArray(result)) throw new Error('Invalid project budget')\n    if (!body) {\n      if (Object.keys(result).length !== 2 || typeof result.available !== 'boolean' || typeof result.committed !== 'boolean' || (result.available && result.committed)) throw new Error('Invalid project budget status')\n      return { available: result.available, committed: result.committed }\n    }\n    if (result.approved === false && Object.keys(result).length === 1) return {}\n    const record = result.record as AstraProjectBudgetRecord | undefined\n    const approved = astraProjectBudget(configuration, userId, env.ACCOUNT_LEDGER_MODE, record?.at as number)\n    if (result.approved !== true || Object.keys(result).length !== 2 || !approved || !matchesAstraProjectBudgetRecord(record, approved, record?.at as number, body.id, body.fingerprint)) throw new Error('Invalid project budget record')\n    return { record }\n  } catch { throw new EntitlementError('The project budget could not be confirmed. Keep the same job; do not start another.') }\n}\nexport async function entitlementStatus(env: EntitlementEnv, userId: string, identity?: AstraSupportIdentity) {\n  const [support, supplemental, repaired, project] = await Promise.all([\n    supportCall(env, userId, identity).catch(() => ({} as { available?: boolean; consumed?: boolean })),\n    supplementalCall(env, userId, identity).catch(() => ({} as { available?: boolean; consumed?: boolean })),\n    repairedMccCall(env, userId, identity).catch(() => ({} as { available?: boolean; consumed?: boolean })),\n    projectBudgetCall(env, userId).catch(() => ({} as { available?: boolean; committed?: boolean })),\n  ]) // Optional support cannot hide ordinary account availability.\n  return entitlementCall<EntitlementStatus>(env, userId, '/status', undefined, { identity, available: support.available, consumed: support.consumed, statusKnown: typeof support.available === 'boolean',\n    supplemental: { available: supplemental.available, consumed: supplemental.consumed, statusKnown: typeof supplemental.available === 'boolean' },\n    repaired: { available: repaired.available, consumed: repaired.consumed, statusKnown: typeof repaired.available === 'boolean' },\n    project: { available: project.available, committed: project.committed, statusKnown: typeof project.available === 'boolean' } })\n}\nexport async function reserveUserGeneration(env: EntitlementEnv, userId: string, jobId: string, profile: GenerationKind, model?: GenerationModel, fingerprint?: string, qualityProfile?: StudioQualityProfile, metadata?: { requiredFundingMode?: typeof PAID_POINTS_FUNDING; paidPointsPolicy?: string | null; overnightTest?: boolean; providerModel?: string; channel?: 'studio' | 'blueprint'; prompt?: string; supportIdentity?: AstraSupportIdentity; pricing?: StudioPricing; blueprintDispatch?: 'fenced-v1'; repairedMccInputEligible?: boolean; projectBudgetInputEligible?: boolean }) {\n  const body = { id: jobId, profile, ...(metadata?.paidPointsPolicy != null ? { paidPointsPolicy: metadata.paidPointsPolicy } : {}), ...(metadata?.requiredFundingMode ? { requiredFundingMode: metadata.requiredFundingMode } : {}), ...(metadata?.providerModel !== undefined ? { providerModel: metadata.providerModel } : {}), ...(metadata?.projectBudgetInputEligible === true ? { projectBudgetInputEligible: true } : {}), ...(metadata?.repairedMccInputEligible === true ? { repairedMccInputEligible: true } : {}), ...(model ? { model } : {}), ...(fingerprint ? { fingerprint } : {}), ...(qualityProfile && qualityProfile !== 'standard' ? { qualityProfile } : {}), ...(metadata?.channel ? { channel: metadata.channel } : {}), ...(metadata?.blueprintDispatch ? { blueprintDispatch: metadata.blueprintDispatch } : {}), ...(metadata?.prompt ? { prompt: metadata.prompt } : {}), ...(metadata?.pricing !== undefined ? { pricing: metadata.pricing } : {}) }\n  if (metadata?.overnightTest) {\n    const workflow = overnightWorkflow(metadata.channel, model ?? (profile === 'fast' ? 'sol' : 'astra'))\n    if (env.ENFORCE_ACCOUNT_ENTITLEMENTS !== 'true' || !workflow || !fingerprint || metadata.pricing !== undefined || metadata.projectBudgetInputEligible || metadata.repairedMccInputEligible)\n      throw new EntitlementError('This request is outside the approved overnight test scope.')\n    const economics = MODEL_ECONOMICS[model ?? (profile === 'fast' ? 'sol' : 'astra')]\n    if (economics.model !== OVERNIGHT_TEST_WORKFLOWS[workflow].model || economics.maxProviderCents !== OVERNIGHT_TEST_WORKFLOWS[workflow].capCents) throw new EntitlementError('The overnight model or price is not reviewed.')\n    const authority = overnightTestAuthority(env, userId, Date.now())\n    if (!authority) throw new EntitlementError('The overnight test authority is unavailable or expired.')\n    const record = await overnightPoolCall(env, userId, '/overnight-test-claim', { jobId, fingerprint, workflow })\n    if (record.approved !== true) return { allowed: false, reason: 'PROVIDER_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED' }\n    if (!matchesOvernightTestClaim(record.claim, authority, jobId, fingerprint, workflow, Date.now())) throw new EntitlementError('The overnight test commitment could not be verified.')\n    const reservation = await entitlementCall<Reservation>(env, userId, '/reserve-overnight-test', { ...body, overnightTestClaim: record.claim })\n    if (reservation.allowed && (reservation.fundingSource !== OVERNIGHT_TEST_APPROVAL || reservation.kind !== 'credits' || reservation.cost !== MODEL_ECONOMICS[model ?? (profile === 'fast' ? 'sol' : 'astra')].creditsPerGeneration))\n      throw new EntitlementError('The overnight account reservation could not be verified.')\n    return reservation\n  }\n  const identity = metadata?.supportIdentity\n  const pointsMember = metadata?.projectBudgetInputEligible === true && (await entitlementCall<EntitlementStatus>(env, userId, '/status')).paidGenerationPolicy === PAID_POINTS_POLICY\n  const selected = !pointsMember && metadata?.projectBudgetInputEligible === true && metadata.channel === 'studio' && profile === 'slow' &&\n    (model === undefined || model === 'astra') && !!fingerprint && metadata.pricing === undefined\n    ? await projectBudgetSelected(env, userId, fingerprint) : false\n  const initial = await entitlementCall<Reservation>(env, userId, '/reserve', body, { identity, project: { selected } })\n  if (initial.allowed || initial.reason !== 'PROVIDER_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED' || metadata?.pricing !== undefined || metadata?.channel !== 'studio' || profile !== 'slow' || (model !== undefined && model !== 'astra') || !fingerprint) return initial\n  if (selected && initial.projectBudgetEligible === true && metadata?.projectBudgetInputEligible === true) {\n    const project = await projectBudgetCall(env, userId, { id: jobId, fingerprint })\n    if (!project.record) return initial\n    const reservation = await entitlementCall<Reservation>(env, userId, '/reserve', body, { identity, project: { record: project.record } })\n    if (!reservation || typeof reservation !== 'object' || Array.isArray(reservation) || typeof reservation.allowed !== 'boolean' ||\n        (reservation.allowed && (reservation.cost !== 250 || reservation.kind !== 'credits' || Object.keys(reservation).length !== 5 ||\n          Object.keys(reservation).some(key => !['allowed', 'repeated', 'cost', 'kind', 'held', 'state'].includes(key)) ||\n          !(reservation.repeated === false && reservation.held === true && reservation.state === undefined ||\n            reservation.repeated === true && ['reserved', 'completed'].includes(String(reservation.state))))))\n      throw new EntitlementError('The project account reservation could not be confirmed. Keep the same job; do not start another.')\n    return reservation\n  }\n  if (selected) return initial\n  // Claim globally before adding account funding. job: Row & { providerLiability: Row; pointSettlement: Row } }>()\n  let allHeld = 0\n  for (const [key, value] of paid) {\n    const id = key.slice(PAID_POINTS_JOB_PREFIX.length)\n    if (!key.startsWith(PAID_POINTS_JOB_PREFIX) || !UUID.test(id) || !valid(value, id) || !row(value) || !isPointSettlement(value.pointSettlement) || !matchingPaidPointsFence(legacy.get('job:' + id), value)) return blocked('JOB_BINDING_INVALID')\n    allHeld += value.pointSettlement.heldPoints\n    const commitment = await hash(id), expected = approved.jobs.find(job => job.idSha256 === commitment)\n    if (!expected) continue\n    if (!boundedIncidentJob(value, id, valid, now) || value.at !== expected.at || value.pointSettlement.state !== 'pending-cost' || value.pointSettlement.heldPoints !== 250 || value.pointSettlement.chargedPoints !== 0) return blocked('JOB_BINDING_INVALID')\n    selected.set(commitment, { id, job: value })\n  }\n  for (const [key, value] of legacy) {\n    if (!key.startsWith('job:') || !row(value)) return blocked('JOB_BINDING_INVALID')\n    if (value.billingMode === 'hold-v1' && value.state === 'reserved' && value.kind === 'credits') {\n      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value.cost) || Number(value.cost) < 0) return blocked('JOB_BINDING_INVALID')\n      allHeld += Number(value.cost)\n    }\n  }\n  if (selected.size !== 4 || allHeld !== 1000) return blocked('JOB_BINDING_INVALID')\n  const updates = [], jobs: JobAudit[] = []\n  let providerLiabilityCents = 0\n  for (const commitment of approved.jobs) {\n    const { id, job } = selected.get(commitment.idSha256)!, waived = { ...job, pointSettlement: waivedPointSettlement() }\n    if (!valid(waived, id)) return blocked('JOB_BINDING_INVALID')\n    const liability = Number(job.providerLiability.maximumLiabilityCents)\n    jobs.push({ id, ...commitment, originalJobSha256: await jobHash(job), waivedJobSha256: await jobHash(waived), providerLiabilityCents: liability })\n    updates.push({ id, waived }); Only the\n  // points markers, held aggregate and audit change; balance/liability never do.\n  for (const { id, waived } of updates) await storage.put(PAID_POINTS_JOB_PREFIX + id, waived)\n  await storage.put(HELD_KEY, 0)\n  await storage.put(FAILED_HOLD_WAIVER_KEY, audit)\n  return { status: 200, body: result }\n}\nasync function validApplyRequest(request: Request): Promise<boolean> {\n  if (!/^application\\/json(?:\\s*;\\s*charset=utf-8)?$/i.test(request.headers.get('Content-Type') ?? 'library.' : held ? Keep your saved model.', 401)\n  const signature = Uint8Array.from(match[4].match(/../g)!, byte => parseInt(byte, 16))\n  const valid = await crypto.subtle.verify('HMAC', await keyOf(env), signature, signingBytes(`${match[1]}.${match[2]}.${match[3]}`, userId, library, held))\n  if (!valid) throw new StudioError('The job receipt is not valid.', 401)\n  if (library && Date.now() - issued >= LIBRARY_TOKEN_TTL_MS) throw new StudioLibraryReceiptExpiredError()\n  return { id: match[1], issued, hash: match[3], library, held }\n}\nconst cursorBytes = (value: string, userId: string) => new TextEncoder().encode(`WORLDIFACT-STUDIO-LIBRARY-CURSOR-v1:/api/studio/library:account:${userId}:${value}`)\nasync function libraryCursor(env: StudioEnv, userId: string, after: string) {\n  const encoded = btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify({ after, issued: Date.now() })))).replace(/\\+/g, '-').replace(/\\//g, '_').replace(/=+$/, '')\n  return `${encoded}.${hex(await crypto.subtle.sign('HMAC', await keyOf(env), cursorBytes(encoded, userId)))}`\n}\nasync function verifyLibraryCursor(env: StudioEnv, userId: string, token: string) {\n  const invalid = () => new StudioError('This account library page expired or is invalid. Refresh your library.', 400)\n  if (token.length > 12_000) throw invalid()\n  const match = /^([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)\\.([a-f0-9]{64})$/.exec(token)\n  if (!match) throw invalid()\n  const signature = Uint8Array.from(match[2].match(/../g)!, byte => parseInt(byte, 16))\n  if (!await crypto.subtle.verify('HMAC', await keyOf(env), signature, cursorBytes(match[1], userId))) throw invalid()\n  try {\n    const value = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder('utf-8', { fatal: true }).decode(Uint8Array.from(atob(match[1].replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/')), char => char.charCodeAt(0))))\n    if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value) || Object.keys(value).length !== 2 ||\n        typeof value.after !== 'string' || !value.after.startsWith('job:') || value.after.length > 2048 ||\n        !Number.isSafeInteger(value.issued) || value.issued > Date.now() + 30_000 || Date.now() - value.issued >= LIBRARY_TOKEN_TTL_MS) throw invalid()\n    return value.after as string\n  } catch { throw invalid() }\n}\nasync function publicLibraryModel(env: StudioEnv, userId: string, model: OwnedStudioLibraryModel): Promise<StudioLibraryModel> {\n  return { id: model.id, prompt: model.prompt, createdAt: new Date(model.at).toISOString(), completedAt: new Date(model.completedAt).toISOString(),\n    receipt: await receipt(env, model.id, model.fingerprint, userId, undefined, true), review: 'UNREVIEWED', downloadAllowed: model.downloadAllowed }\n}\nasync function libraryReadLimit(env: StudioEnv, userId: string) {\n  if (!env.ACCOUNT_LIMITER) throw new StudioError('The account library read limiter is unavailable.', 503)\n  try {\n    if (!(await env.ACCOUNT_LIMITER.limit({ key: `studio-library:${userId}` })).success)\n      throw new StudioError('Please wait before reading more saved models.', 429)\n  } catch (error) {\n    if (error instanceof StudioError) throw error\n    throw new StudioError('The account library read limiter is unavailable.', 503)\n  }\n}\nconst accountPolicy = (env: StudioEnv) => env.ENFORCE_ACCOUNT_ENTITLEMENTS === 'true'\nasync function accountIdentity(request: Request, env: StudioEnv, fetcher: typeof fetch) {\n  if (!accountPolicy(env)) {\n    if (hasTestAccountHeaders(request.headers)) throw new StudioError('Verified test account access is unavailable.', 403, 'ACCOUNT_ADMISSION_UNAVAILABLE')\n    return null\n  }\n  const user = await getVerifiedAccount(request, env, fetcher)\n  if (!user) throw new StudioError('Sign in with your shared WORLDIFACT / Cube Chess account to continue.', 401)\n  if (hasTestAccountHeaders(request.headers) && !testAccountMatches(request.headers, user.id)) throw new StudioError('The signed-in account changed. Reopen the original account before continuing.', 403, 'ACCOUNT_ADMISSION_UNAVAILABLE')\n  return user\n}\nasync function boundDigest(digest: string, userId?: string) {\n  // A prepared receipt cannot be submitted by another account, even before a\n  // per-user ledger reservation exists. Keep legacy hashes only while disabled.\n  return userId ? hex(await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode(`WORLDIFACT-ACCOUNT-JOB-v1:${userId}:${digest}`))) : digest\n}\nconst fundingDigest = async (digest: string, overnightTest = false) => overnightTest ? hex(await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode(`${OVERNIGHT_TEST_APPROVAL}:${digest}`))) : digest\nconst boundInputDigest = async (input: StudioInput, userId?: string, overnightTest = false) => boundDigest(await fundingDigest(await inputDigest(input), overnightTest), userId)\nfunction prepareMetadata(input: StudioInput): StudioPrepareMetadata {\n  const { photos, ...metadata } = input\n  return { ...metadata, photoCount: photos.length }\n}\nfunction checkOvernightPreparation(env: StudioEnv, userId: string | undefined, input: StudioPrepareMetadata) {\n  if (!userId || !accountPolicy(env) || !overnightTestAuthority(env, userId, Date.now())) throw new StudioError('The account-bound overnight test authority is unavailable or expired.', 403)\n  if (studioNewJobPolicy(env.STUDIO_NEW_JOB_POLICY) !== HISTORICAL_STUDIO_POLICY || input.generationProfile !== undefined || input.budgetTier !== undefined || input.pricingRevision !== undefined || input.acceptedPoints !== undefined)\n    throw new StudioError('Overnight detailed tests require the existing 175-cent STANDARD policy, without tier upgrades.', 409)\n}\nfunction repairedMccInputEligible(input: StudioPrepareMetadata): boolean {\n  return input.worldId === 'enchanted-ai-shop' && input.photoCount === 0 &&\n    input.generationProfile === undefined && input.budgetTier === undefined &&\n    input.pricingRevision === undefined && input.acceptedPoints === undefined\n}\nasync function checkRepairedMccPreparation(env: StudioEnv, user: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof accountIdentity>>, input: StudioPrepareMetadata, digest: string) {\n  if (!user || !astraRepairedMccGrant(env.WORLDIFACT_ASTRA_REPAIRED_MCC_GRANT, user.id, env.ACCOUNT_LEDGER_MODE, Date.now(), user.emailVerified ? user.email : null)) return\n  const fingerprint = await boundDigest(digest, user.id)\n  const project = astraProjectBudget(env.WORLDIFACT_ASTRA_PROJECT_BUDGET, user.id, env.ACCOUNT_LEDGER_MODE, Date.now())\n  if (project?.fingerprint === fingerprint && repairedMccInputEligible(input)) return\n  // This optional check reads eligibility only. Ordinary funding and either\n  // earlier allowance retain their existing input contract and never borrow\n  // the separate, exact-draft approval.\n  const status = await entitlementStatus(env, user.id, user)\n  const onlyRepairedMcc = status.astraRepairedMccGrant?.available === true && status.studioAdmission.allowed &&\n    !status.generationAdmission.astra.allowed && status.astraSupportOnce?.available !== true && status.astraSupplementalGrant?.available !== true\n  if (!onlyRepairedMcc) return\n  const approved = astraRepairedMccGrant(env.WORLDIFACT_ASTRA_REPAIRED_MCC_GRANT, user.id, env.ACCOUNT_LEDGER_MODE, Date.now(), user.emailVerified ? user.email : null)\n  if (!approved || !repairedMccInputEligible(input) || approved.fingerprint !== fingerprint) {\n    throw new StudioError('This one-time allowance is reserved for the approved MCC draft. Restore its exact description and settings. No points were reserved.', 409)\n  }\n}\nasync function checkProjectBudgetPreparation(env: StudioEnv, user: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof accountIdentity>>, input: StudioPrepareMetadata, digest: string) {\n  if (!user || !astraProjectBudget(env.WORLDIFACT_ASTRA_PROJECT_BUDGET, user.id, env.ACCOUNT_LEDGER_MODE, Date.now())) return\n  const status = await entitlementStatus(env, user.id, user)\n  const projectOnly = status.astraProjectBudget?.available === true && status.studioAdmission.allowed &&\n    !status.generationAdmission.astra.allowed && status.astraSupportOnce?.available !== true &&\n    status.astraSupplementalGrant?.available !== true && status.astraRepairedMccGrant?.available !== true\n  if (!projectOnly) return\n  const fingerprint = await boundDigest(digest, user.id)\n  const approved = astraProjectBudget(env.WORLDIFACT_ASTRA_PROJECT_BUDGET, user.id, env.ACCOUNT_LEDGER_MODE, Date.now())\n  if (!approved || !repairedMccInputEligible(input) || approved.fingerprint !== fingerprint) {\n    throw new StudioError('This project budget covers one approved MCC draft. Restore its exact description and settings. No points were reserved.', 409)\n  }\n}\nasync function accountAccess(env: StudioEnv, userId: string | undefined, id: string) {\n  if (!userId) return null\n  const access = await userJobAccess(env, userId, id)\n  if (!access.owned) throw new StudioError('This model belongs to a different account or has no account receipt.', 403)\n  return access\n}\nconst outputChecks = new Map<string, Promise<'valid' | 'invalid'>>()\nasync function validateCompletedModel(env: StudioEnv, userId: string, id: string, fetcher: typeof fetch, qualityProfile: StudioQualityProfile = 'standard') {\n  const key = `${userId}:${id}:${qualityProfile}`\n  const existing = outputChecks.get(key)\n  if (existing) return existing\n  // Coalesce same-job polling. This is a byte/structure check, not perceptual QA.\n  if (outputChecks.size >= 1) throw new StudioVerificationBusyError('Model verification is busy. Recover the same job; do not generate again.', 503)\n  const check = (async (): Promise<'valid' | 'invalid'> => {\n    let response: Response\n    try { response = await modelOrExport(env, id, 'model', fetcher) }\n    catch (e) { if (e instanceof InvalidStudioModelError) return 'invalid'; throw e }\n    const bytes = await response.arrayBuffer() // Interrupted reads are uncertain, not an automatic refund.\n    try {\n      return passesStudioStructuralQuality(inspectGLB(bytes), qualityProfile) ? 'valid' : 'invalid'\n    } catch { return 'invalid' }\n  })()\n  outputChecks.set(key, check)\n  try { return await check } finally { if (outputChecks.get(key) === check) outputChecks.delete(key) }\n}\ntype TimingObservation = { value?: StudioGenerationTiming }\nasync function accountJob(env: StudioEnv, userId: string | undefined, id: string, state: StudioJob['state'], fetcher: typeof fetch = fetch, failureCode?: StudioJob['failureCode'], timingObservation?: TimingObservation): Promise<StudioJob> {\n  if (!userId) return { id, state, detail: JOB_DETAILS[state] }\n  const previous = await accountAccess(env, userId, id)\n  // Customer incident compensation is final and independent of the preserved\n  // provider liability. Reading this failed job must not reopen either ledger.\n  if (previous?.owned && previous.state === 'failed' && previous.pointSettlement?.state === 'waived') return {\n    id, state: 'failed', detail: POINT_COST_WAIVED_DETAIL, pointSettlement: previous.pointSettlement,\n    ...(previous.failureCode ? { failureCode: previous.failureCode } : {}), ...(previous.pricing ? { pricing: previous.pricing } : {}),\n    downloadAllowed: false, previewOnly: false, previewAvailable: false,\n  }\n  if (previous?.state === 'failed' && !(previous.pointSettlement?.state === 'pending-cost' && state === 'succeeded')) { state = 'failed'; failureCode = previous.failureCode }\n  if (previous?.state === 'completed') { state = 'succeeded'; failureCode = undefined }\n  if (previous?.state === 'reserved' && previous.at && Date.now() - previous.at > STUDIO_JOB_WATCHDOG_MS && !['succeeded','failed','cancelled'].includes(state)) {\n    state = 'failed'\n    failureCode = 'STUDIO_TIMEOUT'\n  }\n  if (state === 'succeeded' && (previous?.state === 'reserved' || previous?.pointSettlement?.state === 'pending-cost')) {\n    try {\n      if (await validateCompletedModel(env, userId, id, fetcher, previous.qualityProfile ?? 'standard') !== 'valid') { state = 'failed'; failureCode = 'INVALID_MODEL_OUTPUT' }\n    } catch (error) {\n      if (error instanceof StudioVerificationBusyError || !previous.at || Date.now() - previous.at <= STUDIO_JOB_WATCHDOG_MS) throw error\n      // A success label without recoverable, verified model bytes cannot keep\n      // the customer's hold indefinitely either. Do not claim Oracle cancelled.\n      state = 'failed'; failureCode = 'STUDIO_TIMEOUT'\n    }\n  }\n  if (state === 'succeeded') await settleUserGeneration(env, userId, id, 'completed', undefined, previous?.pointSettlement?.state === 'pending-cost')\n  if (state === 'failed' || state === 'cancelled') {\n    const settlement = await settleUserGeneration(env, userId, id, 'failed', failureCode)\n    if (!settlement.settled) { state = 'pending'; failureCode = undefined }\n  }\n  let access = await accountAccess(env, userId, id)\n  // A concurrent poll may have won settlement. Report its durable result,\n  // never an uncommitted failure or a refund for a previously completed job.\n  if (access?.state === 'failed') { state = 'failed'; failureCode = access.failureCode }\n  if (access?.state === 'completed') { state = 'succeeded'; failureCode = undefined }\n  if (access?.providerBudgetPending === true && access.pointSettlement?.state !== 'waived') {\n    await reconcileProviderReservation(env, userId, id, fetcher)\n    access = await accountAccess(env, userId, id)\n  }\n  // Reconciliation may race a separately verified late completion. Re-read\n  // generation state together with its financial state before reporting either.\n  if (access?.state === 'failed') { state = 'failed'; failureCode = access.failureCode }\n  if (access?.state === 'completed') { state = 'succeeded'; failureCode = undefined }\n  // A provider success label is insufficient: completion is emitted only after\n  // the existing GLB gate and durable account settlement agree. Recovered\n  // terminal results are observations, not proof of a new provider dispatch.\n  if (access?.state === 'completed' || access?.state === 'failed') {\n    const completed = access.state === 'completed'\n    const reason = completed ? 'MODEL_COMPLETED' : failureCode && STUDIO_FAILURE_CODES.includes(failureCode) ? failureCode : 'MODEL_FAILED'\n    logStudioDiagnostic({ requestId: id, stage: completed ? 'COMPLETED' : 'FAILED', admission: 'RECOVERY_ONLY', reason, oracleDispatch: 'UNKNOWN', workerStatus: null })\n  }\n  const detail = access?.pointSettlement?.state === 'waived' ? POINT_COST_WAIVED_DETAIL : access?.pointSettlement?.state === 'pending-cost' ? POINT_COST_PENDING_DETAIL : failureCode ? STUDIO_FAILURE_DETAILS[failureCode] : JOB_DETAILS[state]\n  const generationTiming = access?.owned && access.pointSettlement?.state !== 'waived' && ['completed', 'failed'].includes(access.state!)\n    ? timingObservation ? timingObservation.value : await oracleGenerationTiming(env, id, fetcher) : undefined\n  return { id, state, detail, ...(access?.pointSettlement ? { pointSettlement: access.pointSettlement } : {}), ...(failureCode ? { failureCode } : {}), downloadAllowed: access!.downloadAllowed,\n    ...(generationTiming ? { generationTiming } : {}),\n    previewOnly: access!.previewOnly, previewAvailable: access!.downloadAllowed, ...(access?.pricing ? { pricing: access.pricing } : {}) }\n}\nasync function limitedJson(response: Request | Response, limit: number) {\n  if (!response.headers.get('content-type')?.toLowerCase().startsWith('application/json')) throw new StudioError('Expected application/json.', 415)\n  if (Number(response.headers.get('content-length') || 0) > limit) throw new StudioError('Request or response is too large.', 413)\n  const reader = response.body?.getReader()\n  if (!reader) throw new StudioError('No request data.')\n  let size = 0, text = ''; const decoder = new TextDecoder()\n  try {\n    for (;;) {\n      const { value, done } = await reader.read(); if (done) break\n      size += value.length\n      if (size > limit) throw new StudioError('Request or response is too large.', 413)\n      text += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true })\n    }\n    const result: unknown = JSON.parse(text + decoder.decode())\n    if (!result || typeof result !== 'object' || Array.isArray(result)) throw new StudioError('Expected a JSON object.')\n    return result as Record<string, unknown>\n  } catch (error) { await reader.cancel().catch(() => {}); if (error instanceof StudioError) throw error; throw new StudioError('Invalid JSON data.') }\n}\nasync function inputFrom(request: Request, overnightTest = false) {\n  const raw = await limitedJson(request, STUDIO_BODY_LIMIT)\n  const value = overnightTest ? readTestInputEnvelope(raw, request.headers) : raw\n  if (!value) throw new StudioError('Refresh the test page to verify its account contract. Nothing was submitted.', 409, 'ACCOUNT_ADMISSION_UNAVAILABLE')\n  try { return validateStudioInput(value) } catch (e) { throw new StudioError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Invalid model input.', 400) }\n}\nasync function limit(request: Request, env: StudioEnv, bucket: string) {\n  if (!env.GENERATION_LIMITER) throw new StudioError('Request limiter is unavailable.', 503)\n  try {\n    const key = `studio:${bucket}:${request.headers.get('CF-Connecting-IP') || 'unknown-client'}`\n    if (!(await env.GENERATION_LIMITER.limit({ key })).success) throw new StudioError('Please wait before checking or submitting again.', 429)\n  } catch (e) { if (e instanceof StudioError) throw e; throw new StudioError('Request limiter is unavailable.', 503) }\n}\nfunction budget(env: StudioEnv) {\n  if (!env.GENERATION_BUDGET) throw new StudioError('The shared allowance is not configured.', 503)\n  return env.GENERATION_BUDGET.get(env.GENERATION_BUDGET.idFromName('worldifact-generation-budget-v1'))\n}\nasync function allowance(env: StudioEnv) {\n  const response = await budget(env).fetch(new Request('https://budget.internal/status', { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000) }))\n  if (!response.ok) throw new StudioError('The shared allowance could not be read.', 503)\n  const state = await limitedJson(response, 2000)\n  const unlimited = state.unlimited === true\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(state.used) || Number(state.used) < 0 || typeof state.enabled !== 'boolean' ||\n      (unlimited ? state.limit !== null || state.remaining !== null : ![state.limit, state.remaining].every(n => Number.isSafeInteger(n) && Number(n) >= 0)))\n    throw new StudioError('Invalid allowance response.', 503)\n  return { used: Number(state.used), limit: unlimited ? null : Number(state.limit), remaining: unlimited ? null : Number(state.remaining), enabled: state.enabled,\n    expiresAt: typeof state.expiresAt === 'string' ? state.expiresAt : null, unlimited, fastOnly: state.fastOnly === true }\n}\nasync function oracle(env: StudioEnv, path: string, fetcher: typeof fetch, init: RequestInit = {}, timeoutMs?: number) {\n  const origin = oracleOrigin(env.ORACLE_ENDPOINT)\n  if (!origin || !env.ORACLE_API_TOKEN) throw new StudioError('The existing Oracle connection is not configured.', 503)\n  return fetcher(origin + path, { ...init, redirect: 'manual', signal: AbortSignal.timeout(timeoutMs ?? (path.endsWith('/budget') ? 5000 : path.includes('/model') || path.includes('/exports/') ? 180_000 : STUDIO_ORACLE_TIMEOUT_MS)),\n    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${env.ORACLE_API_TOKEN}`, Accept: path.includes('/model') ? 'model/gltf-binary' : path.includes('/exports/') ? 'application/octet-stream, application/zip' : 'application/json', ...(init.body ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } : {}) } })\n}\nfunction qualityGenerationTiming(quality: Record<string, unknown>): StudioGenerationTiming | undefined {\n  if (quality.revision !== 6 || typeof quality.state !== 'string' || !['succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled'].includes(quality.state) ||\n      !quality.timing || typeof quality.timing !== 'object' || Array.isArray(quality.timing)) return undefined\n  return readStudioGenerationTiming({ source: 'oracle-worker', durationSeconds: (quality.timing as Record<string, unknown>).total_seconds })\n}\n/** Optional read-only metadata for an already-owned terminal job. Never infer\n * runtime from receipt/ledger dates or let unavailable timing hide its outcome.\n * Oracle writes timing after terminal status; a missing record stays unknown\n * until a later explicit recovery/read, without an immediate retry. */\nasync function oracleGenerationTiming(env: StudioEnv, id: string, fetcher: typeof fetch): Promise<StudioGenerationTiming | undefined> {\n  try {\n    const response = await oracle(env, `/v1/jobs/${id}/quality`, fetcher, {}, 5000)\n    if (!response.ok) { await response.body?.cancel(); return undefined }\n    return qualityGenerationTiming(await limitedJson(response, 262_144))\n  } catch { return undefined }\n}\n/** Only an authenticated, immutable terminal upper-liability receipt can return\n * unused provider funding. A failure label or missing ledger never means zero.\n * Older Oracle installations stay compatible: unavailable evidence leaves the\n * reservation intact and must not hide an already settled model outcome. */\nasync function reconcileProviderReservation(env: StudioEnv, userId: string, id: string, fetcher: typeof fetch) {\n  try {\n    const response = await oracle(env, `/v1/jobs/${id}/budget`, fetcher)\n    if (!response.ok) { await response.body?.cancel(); return false }\n    const value = await limitedJson(response, 4096)\n    if (!validateTerminalBudgetReceipt(value, id)) return false\n    const result = await reconcileUserStudioProvider(env, userId, id, value)\n    return result.reconciled === true\n  } catch {\n    // Transport, schema and atomic-write failures preserve the existing debit.\n    // Recovery of this same receipt can try again; no generation is requested.\n    return false\n  }\n}\nfunction oracleFailureCode(value: Record<string, unknown>): StudioJob['failureCode'] {\n  if (value.state === 'cancelled') return 'ORACLE_CANCELLED'\n  if (value.state !== 'failed') return undefined\n  if (value.worldifactFailureCode === 'ORACLE_JOB_INCOMPLETE' || value.worldifactFailureCode === 'INVALID_MODEL_OUTPUT' || value.worldifactFailureCode === 'ASTRA_COST_LIMIT' || value.worldifactFailureCode === 'MODEL_BUDGET_EXCEEDED') return value.worldifactFailureCode\n  return typeof value.detail === 'string' && /astra budget guard|WORLDIFACT_ASTRA_COST_GUARD|astra job budget exhausted/i.test(value.detail)\n    ? 'ASTRA_COST_LIMIT' : 'ORACLE_JOB_FAILED'\n}\nasync function submissionFailureCode(response: Response): Promise<NonNullable<StudioJob['failureCode']>> {\n  if (response.status === 429) { await response.body?.cancel(); return 'RATE_LIMITED' }\n  // Exact reviewed /v1/jobs errors only. Unknown or private provider text is\n  // never persisted, returned, or guessed to mean that all 409s are \"busy\".\n  let value: Record<string, unknown> | undefined\n  try { value = await limitedJson(response, 4096) } catch { await response.body?.cancel().catch(() => {}) }\n  if (response.status === 409 && typeof value?.error === 'string') {\n    if (value.error === 'Serwer wykonuje poprzedni model. Poczekaj na wynik lub anuluj tamto zlecenie.') return 'ORACLE_BUSY'\n    if (value.error === 'Na serwerze zostalo mniej niz 2 GB wolnego miejsca.') return 'STORAGE_FULL'\n    if (value.error === 'Osiagnieto limit 300 zlecen. Zarchiwizuj modele na serwerze przed dalsza praca.') return 'JOB_CAPACITY'\n  }\n  return 'ORACLE_SUBMISSION_REJECTED'\n}\n/** Oracle v33 preserves unfinished candidates under state=succeeded. A retained\n * draft is useful diagnostic evidence, never proof of a completed paid model. */\nasync function completedOracleStatus(env: StudioEnv, id: string, value: Record<string, unknown>, fetcher: typeof fetch): Promise<Record<string, unknown> & { timingObservation?: TimingObservation }> {\n  if (value.state !== 'succeeded' || value.modelStatus !== 'draft') return { ...value, timingObservation: undefined }\n  const response = await oracle(env, `/v1/jobs/${id}/quality`, fetcher)\n  if (!response.ok) { await response.body?.cancel(); throw new StudioError('The worker completion evidence is temporarily unavailable. Recover this same job.', 502) }\n  const quality = await limitedJson(response, 262_144)\n  if (quality.revision !== 6 || quality.state !== 'succeeded' || quality.hasModel !== true || quality.modelStatus !== 'draft' || quality.automaticQualityAccepted !== false)\n    throw new StudioError('The worker completion evidence is inconsistent. Recover this same job.', 502)\n  const record = (v: unknown): v is Record<string, unknown> => !!v && typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v)\n  const usage = record(quality.agentUsage) ? quality.agentUsage : {}\n  const agent = record(quality.agent) ? quality.agent : {}\n  // Only a fixed allowlisted code crosses this boundary. No raw provider/tool\n  // diagnostics, original brief, generated scripts or images are retained.\n  // A deliberately finished unreviewed model keeps the existing structural\n  // acceptance path. Only an execution that never finished is rejected here.\n  const timingObservation = { value: qualityGenerationTiming(quality) }\n  if (agent.finished === true) return { ...value, timingObservation }\n  const failureCode: StudioJob['failureCode'] = value.worldifactFailureCode === 'MODEL_BUDGET_EXCEEDED' ? 'MODEL_BUDGET_EXCEEDED' : usage.error_code === 'WORLDIFACT_ASTRA_COST_GUARD' ? 'ASTRA_COST_LIMIT' : 'ORACLE_JOB_INCOMPLETE'\n  return { ...value, state: 'failed', worldifactFailureCode: failureCode, timingObservation }\n}\nasync function oracleJobStatus(env: StudioEnv, id: string, fetcher: typeof fetch, requireId: boolean) {\n  const response = await oracle(env, `/v1/jobs/${id}`, fetcher)\n  if (response.status === 404) { await response.body?.cancel(); return null }\n  if (!response.ok) { await response.body?.cancel(); throw new StudioError('Status temporarily unavailable. Keep the same job.', response.status === 429 ? 429 : 502) }\n  const value = await limitedJson(response, 16_384)\n  if (((requireId || value.id !== undefined) && value.id !== id) || !Object.hasOwn(JOB_DETAILS, String(value.state)))\n    throw new StudioError('The worker returned an invalid job status.', 502)\n  return completedOracleStatus(env, id, value, fetcher)\n}\nasync function health(env: StudioEnv, fetcher: typeof fetch) {\n  const response = await oracle(env, '/v1/health', fetcher)\n  if (!response.ok) { await response.body?.cancel(); throw new StudioError('The existing worker did not confirm readiness.', 503) }\n  const state = await limitedJson(response, 16_384)\n  const compatible = state.ready === true && state.provider === 'openai' && state.model === 'gpt-6-astra' && Number.isSafeInteger(state.connectorVersion) && Number(state.connectorVersion) >= 33\n  const fastReady = compatible && supportsFastDraft(state)\n  return { ...detailedRuntime(state), ready: compatible, photoReady: compatible && state.photoInput === true, fastReady,\n    // Read-only evidence of the exact reviewed no-AI export helper. Unknown or\n    // newer revisions require review; this does not invoke or enable exports.\n    exportPreparationReady: compatible && state.posthocExportRevision === 2 && state.legacyGlbExportRecoveryRevision === 1,\n    fastBudgetReady: fastReady && state.fastBudgetRevision === 'fast-usd4-v1' && state.fastBudgetMaxUsd === 4,\n    promptMaxLength: state.promptMaxLength === 5000 ? 5000 : 2000 }\n}\nasync function preflight(request: Request, env: StudioEnv, fetcher: typeof fetch, input: StudioPrepareMetadata, userId?: string) {\n  if (input.generationProfile === FAST_DRAFT_PROFILE) throw new StudioError('FAST uses the separate GPT-6.1 Sol blueprint path. The Astra Oracle worker will not accept FAST jobs.', 409)\n  const pool = await allowance(env)\n  const trial = pool.fastOnly && env.ENABLE_APPROVED_FAST_TEST === 'true'\n  if (!trial && (env.ENABLE_STUDIO_JOBS !== 'true' || !budgetSettings(env))) throw new StudioError('Model generation is disabled or its allowance has expired.', 503)\n  if (trial) {\n    if (input.generationProfile !== FAST_DRAFT_PROFILE) throw new StudioError('The approved extra attempt is FAST only. Select FAST DRAFT; no request was charged.', 409)\n    if (!await ownerAuthorized(request, env.OWNER_ACCESS_TOKEN!))\n      await verifyReceipt(env, request.headers.get('X-WORLDIFACT-Previous-Job') || '', undefined, false, userId)\n  } else if (env.PUBLIC_PILOT !== 'true' && !await ownerAuthorized(request, env.OWNER_ACCESS_TOKEN!)) throw new StudioError('This generation window requires owner access.', 401)\n  const policy = studioNewJobPolicy(env.STUDIO_NEW_JOB_POLICY)\n  if (!policy) throw new StudioError('New model requests are awaiting a verified budget policy. Existing jobs can still be recovered.', 503)\n  if (policy === HISTORICAL_STUDIO_POLICY && input.budgetTier !== undefined)\n    throw new StudioError(STUDIO_FAILURE_DETAILS.STUDIO_BUDGET_POLICY_CHANGED, 409, 'STUDIO_BUDGET_POLICY_CHANGED')\n  const current = await health(env, fetcher)\n  if (!current.ready) throw new StudioError('The existing Astra/Blender worker is not ready.', 503)\n  if (accountPolicy(env) && !current.costGuardReady) throw new StudioError('The detailed worker did not confirm the current Astra cost guard. No points were reserved.', 503)\n  if (accountPolicy(env) && !current.outputPolicyReady) throw new StudioError('The detailed worker requires the reviewed Astra output policy. No points were reserved.', 503)\n  if (input.budgetTier !== undefined && (!userId || !accountPolicy(env) || !current.tiersReady)) throw new StudioError('The worker has not confirmed the selected Studio price and cost ceiling. Refresh availability; no points were reserved.', 503)\n  if (trial && !current.fastBudgetReady) throw new StudioError('The approved cost guard is not confirmed. No paid request was sent.', 503)\n  if (input.generationProfile === FAST_DRAFT_PROFILE && (!current.fastReady || !current.fastBudgetReady)) throw new StudioError('FAST DRAFT is not fully verified on the worker. No paid job was submitted; STANDARD remains available.', 409)\n  if (input.photoCount && !current.photoReady) throw new StudioError('This worker has not confirmed photo input. Nothing was submitted.', 409)\n  if (oracleStudioPayload('', { ...input, photos: [] }).prompt.length > current.promptMaxLength) throw new StudioError(`Shorten the description: the worker accepts ${current.promptMaxLength} characters including export instructions.`)\n  return { ...current, trial }\n}\nasync function modelOrExport(env: StudioEnv, id: string, format: string, fetcher: typeof fetch) {\n  const model = format === 'model'\n  const profile = model ? { name: 'model.glb', type: 'model/gltf-binary', limit: STUDIO_MODEL_LIMIT } : EXPORTS[format]\n  if (!profile) throw new StudioError('Unsupported export format.', 404)\n  const response = await oracle(env, model ? `/v1/jobs/${id}/model` : `/v1/jobs/${id}/exports/${format}`, fetcher)\n  if (!response.ok) { await response.body?.cancel(); throw new StudioError('This model/export is not available on the worker yet.', [404, 409, 429].includes(response.status) ? response.status : 502) }\n  const size = Number(response.headers.get('content-length'))\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(size) || size < (model ? 20 : 1) || size > profile.limit || !response.body) { await response.body?.cancel(); throw new StudioError('The export is incomplete or exceeds its download limit.', 413) }\n  const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type')?.split(';')[0].trim().toLowerCase()\n  if (model && !['model/gltf-binary', 'application/octet-stream'].includes(contentType || '')) { await response.body.cancel(); throw new StudioError('The worker did not return a GLB.', 502) }\n  const reader = response.body.getReader(), initial: Uint8Array[] = []; let initialSize = 0\n  if (model) {\n    while (initialSize < 12) {\n      const next = await reader.read()\n      if (next.done) { await reader.cancel(); throw new StudioError('The model download is incomplete.', 502) }\n      initial.push(next.value); initialSize += next.value.byteLength\n      if (initialSize > size) { await reader.cancel(); throw new StudioError('The model size is invalid.', 502) }\n    }\n    const first = new Uint8Array(12); let at = 0\n    for (const chunk of initial) { const part = chunk.subarray(0, Math.min(12 - at, chunk.length)); first.set(part, at); at += part.length; if (at === 12) break }\n    const header = new DataView(first.buffer)\n    if (header.getUint32(0, true) !== 0x46546c67 || header.getUint32(4, true) !== 2 || header.getUint32(8, true) !== size) { await reader.cancel(); throw new InvalidStudioModelError('The worker returned an invalid GLB container.', 502) }\n  }\n  let received = 0\n  const stream = new ReadableStream<Uint8Array>({\n    async pull(controller) {\n      try {\n        const value = initial.shift(), next = value ? { done: false, value } : await reader.read()\n        if (next.done) { if (received !== size) throw new Error('Incomplete export'); controller.close(); return }\n        received += next.value.length\n        if (received > size) throw new Error('Invalid export size')\n        controller.enqueue(next.value)\n      } catch { await reader.cancel().catch(() => {}); controller.error(new Error('Artifact interrupted. Retry the artifact, not generation.')) }\n    }, cancel: () => reader.cancel(),\n  })\n  return new Response(stream, { headers: { 'Content-Type': profile.type, 'Content-Length': String(size), 'Content-Disposition': `attachment; filename=\"WORLDIFACT-${id}-${profile.name}\"`, 'Cache-Control': 'private, no-store', 'X-Content-Type-Options': 'nosniff', 'X-WORLDIFACT-Provenance': 'GENERATED-UNREVIEWED' } })\n}\nexport async function studioApi(request: Request, env: StudioEnv, fetcher: typeof fetch = fetch, overnightTest = false): Promise<Response> {\n  const url = new No receipt was replaced.')\n    const values: unknown = JSON.parse(raw)\n    if (!Array.isArray(values) || values.length > 1000) throw new Error('Saved cost review receipts need attention. No receipt was replaced.')\n    const entries = values.map(parseSavedStudioJob)\n    if (new Set(entries.map(entry => entry.receipt.id)).size !== entries.length || entries.some(entry => entry.pointSettlement ? !['held', 'pending-cost'].includes(entry.pointSettlement.state) : entry.fundingSource !== PAID_POINTS_FUNDING)) throw new Error('Saved cost review receipts need attention. No receipt was replaced.')\n    return entries\n  }\n  pendingCostReviews(): SavedStudioJob[] { return this.readCostReviews(this.reviewKey()) }\n  private rememberCostReview(saved: SavedStudioJob, job: StudioJob, key: string | null) {\n    if ((!job.pointSettlement && !job.pointSettlementUnconfirmed) || !key) return\n    // This local index is only a convenience. The authenticated account funding\n    // read retains every unresolved hold; cache limits never become job quotas.\n    try {\n    const entries = this.readCostReviews(key), previous = entries.findIndex(entry => entry.receipt.id === saved.receipt.id)\n    if (studioPointsPending(job)) {\n      const retained: SavedStudioJob = { ...saved, fundingSource: PAID_POINTS_FUNDING, ...(job.pointSettlement ? { pointSettlement: job.pointSettlement } : {}) }\n      this.preserveReceipt(retained)\n      if (previous === -1) entries.push(retained); else entries[previous] = retained\n    } else if (previous !== -1) entries.splice(previous, 1)\n    else return\n    const text = JSON.stringify(entries)\n    if (entries.length > 1000 || text.length > 1_048_576) throw new Error('Saved cost review storage is full. Keep this receipt before starting another request.')\n    this.store.setItem(key, text)\n    if (this.store.getItem(key) !== text) throw new Error('The cost review receipt could not be retained. No replacement request was started.')\n    } catch { /* Keep the active receipt and authoritative account review listing. */ }\n  }\n  async recoverCostReview(id: string): Promise<StudioJob> {\n    const saved = this.pendingCostReviews().find(entry => entry.receipt.id === id)\n    if (!saved) throw new Error('No held-point review receipt is saved for this account and job.')\n    return this.poll(saved)\n  }\n  get current() { return this.saved }\n  restore() {\n    this.saved = readSavedStudioJob(this.store)\n    this.rejectedJob = this.saved?.rejection ? { id: this.saved.receipt.id, ...(this.saved.pricing ? { pricing: this.saved.pricing } : {}), state: 'failed', detail: this.saved.rejectionCode ? Nothing was overwritten.')\n      let original: SavedStudioJob, revision: SavedStudioJob\n      try { original = parseSavedStudioJob(JSON.parse(existing)); revision = parseSavedStudioJob(saved) }\n      catch { throw conflict() }\n      if (original.receipt.ticket === saved.receipt.ticket && original.prompt === saved.prompt && original.startedAt === saved.startedAt && JSON.stringify(original.pricing) === JSON.stringify(saved.pricing) && original.generationProfile === saved.generationProfile) return // The immutable original remains; review metadata is separately indexed.\n      const [, originalIssued, originalFingerprint] = receiptParts(original.receipt.ticket)\n      const [, issued, fingerprint] = receiptParts(revision.receipt.ticket)\n      if (original.receipt.id !== revision.receipt.id || originalFingerprint !== fingerprint || originalIssued === issued || original.receipt.ticket.startsWith('held.') !== revision.receipt.ticket.startsWith('held.')) throw conflict()\n      // Cloud recovery re-signs the same account-bound job at a new timestamp.\n      // Keep the canonical history immutable and retain each credential revision.\n      key += `:${issued}`\n      existing = this.store.getItem(key)\n      if (existing !== null && existing !== text) throw conflict()\n    }\n    if (existing === null) this.store.setItem(key, text)\n    if (this.store.getItem(key) !== text) throw new Error('The previous receipt could not be retained. No new model was submitted.')\n  }\n  private retainWaiver(saved: SavedStudioJob, job: StudioJob): SavedStudioJob {\n    if (job.pointSettlement?.state !== 'waived') return saved\n    // Keep the original failed description and credential history before\n    // caching this final customer settlement. A waiver never creates a model.\n    this.preserveReceipt(saved)\n    return { ...saved, fundingSource: PAID_POINTS_FUNDING, pointSettlement: job.pointSettlement, rejection: POINT_COST_WAIVED_DETAIL,\n      ...(job.failureCode ? { rejectionCode: job.failureCode } : {}) }\n  }\n  async start(input: StudioInput, onPrepared: (saved: SavedStudioJob) => void, owner = '', replaceCompleted = false, fundingSource?: typeof PAID_POINTS_FUNDING): Promise<StudioJob> {\n    if (fundingSource !== undefined && fundingSource !== PAID_POINTS_FUNDING) throw new Error('The new request funding policy could not be verified.')\n    const reviewKey = this.reviewKey()\n    if (this.recovering) throw new Error('Wait for cloud recovery to finish before starting a new job.')\n    if (this.submitting || (this.saved && (!replaceCompleted || !canSubmitNewDraft(this.saved.receipt.id, this.confirmedJob))))\n      throw new Error('A job is already selected. Recover it instead of sending another paid request.')\n    this.submitting = true\n    const previous = this.saved\n    try {\n      const snapshot = validateStudioInput(input), body = JSON.stringify(snapshot)\n      const prepareBody = JSON.stringify(await prepareStudioInput(snapshot))\n      // The previous signed receipt proves existing access for the one approved\n      // trial. It stays in a same-origin header, never a URL or a public log.\n      const previousHeaders: Record<string, string> = previous ? { 'X-WORLDIFACT-Previous-Job': previous.receipt.ticket } : {}\n      const fundingHeaders: Record<string, string> = fundingSource ? { [PAID_POINTS_POLICY_HEADER]: fundingSource } : {}\n      const prepared = await this.fetcher('/api/studio/prepare', {\n        method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...accessHeaders(owner), ...previousHeaders, ...fundingHeaders }, body: prepareBody, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(STUDIO_PREPARE_TIMEOUT_MS),\n      })\n      const receipt = readReceipt(await responseJson(prepared))\n      if (receipt.ticket.startsWith('held.') !== (fundingSource === PAID_POINTS_FUNDING)) throw new Error('The prepared receipt did not confirm this request’s funding policy. No model was submitted.')\n      if (snapshot.pricingRevision) {\n        const expected = studioPricingFor(snapshot)\n        if (!receipt.pricing || receipt.pricing.revision !== expected.revision || receipt.pricing.tier !== expected.tier || receipt.pricing.points !== expected.points || receipt.pricing.maxProviderCents !== expected.maxProviderCents)\n          throw new Error('The prepared receipt did not confirm your selected model budget and points. No generation was submitted; review availability before trying again.')\n      }\n      if (previous?.receipt.id === receipt.id) throw new Error('A new model requires a new receipt. The previous model was not changed.')\n      const saved: SavedStudioJob = { receipt, prompt: snapshot.prompt, startedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n        ...(fundingSource ? { fundingSource } : {}),\n        ...(snapshot.pricingRevision ? { pricing: { ...studioPricingFor(snapshot) } } : {}),\n        ...(snapshot.generationProfile === FAST_DRAFT_PROFILE ? { generationProfile: FAST_DRAFT_PROFILE } : {}) }\n      if (previous) this.preserveReceipt(previous)\n      this.store.setItem(STUDIO_RECEIPT_KEY, JSON.stringify(saved))\n      if (this.store.getItem(STUDIO_RECEIPT_KEY) !== JSON.stringify(saved)) throw new Error('The browser could not retain your receipt. No paid request was submitted.')\n      this.saved = saved; this.confirmedJob = null; this.rejectedJob = null; onPrepared(saved)\n      try {\n        const result = await this.fetcher('/api/studio/jobs', {\n          method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-WORLDIFACT-Job': receipt.ticket, 'X-WORLDIFACT-Idempotency-Key': receipt.id, ...accessHeaders(owner), ...previousHeaders, ...fundingHeaders },\n          body, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(STUDIO_SUBMIT_TIMEOUT_MS),\n        })\n        const job = parseStudioJob(await responseJson(result, receipt.id, saved.fundingSource === PAID_POINTS_FUNDING), receipt.id, saved.pricing?.points ?? Keep it terminal so a denied account does not poll forever.\n        if (error instanceof StudioResponseError && ([400, 401, 403, 409, 422, 429].includes(error.status) || error.failureCode !== undefined)) {\n          if (error.pointSettlement && !isPointSettlement(error.pointSettlement, saved.pricing?.points ?? (saved.generationProfile === FAST_DRAFT_PROFILE ? 50 : 250))) return { id: receipt.id, state: 'pending', detail: 'The point settlement needs review. Recover this same request; no charge or refund is inferred.' }\n          if (error.pointSettlement?.state === 'held') return { id: receipt.id, state: 'pending', pointSettlement: error.pointSettlement, detail: 'The points remain held while this request’s result is unconfirmed. Recover the same job; no charge, refund or replacement is inferred.' }\n          if (error.pointSettlement?.state === 'charged') return { id: receipt.id, state: 'pending', detail: 'The response and point settlement disagree. Recover the same job; no charge or refund is inferred.' }\n          this.rejectedJob = { id: receipt.id, ...(saved.pricing ? { pricing: saved.pricing } : {}), state: 'failed', detail: error.message, ...(error.failureCode ? { failureCode: error.failureCode } : {}), ...(error.pointSettlement ? { pointSettlement: error.pointSettlement } : {}) }\n          if (saved.fundingSource === PAID_POINTS_FUNDING && !error.pointSettlement) { this.rejectedJob.pointSettlementUnconfirmed = true; this.rejectedJob.detail = studioPendingPointsDetail() }\n          this.confirmedJob = this.rejectedJob\n          this.saved = { ...saved, rejection: error.message, ...(error.failureCode ? { rejectionCode: error.failureCode } : {}), ...(error.pointSettlement ? { pointSettlement: error.pointSettlement } : {}) }\n          this.rememberCostReview(this.saved, this.rejectedJob, reviewKey)\n          try { this.store.setItem(STUDIO_RECEIPT_KEY, JSON.stringify(this.saved)) } catch { /* Explicit rejection is still terminal in this tab. */ }\n          return this.rejectedJob\n        }\n        return { id: receipt.id, state: 'pending', detail: JOB_DETAILS.pending, ...(saved.pricing ? { pricing: saved.pricing } : {}) }\n      }\n    } finally { this.submitting = false }\n  }\n  async poll(saved = this.saved): Promise<StudioJob> {\n    if (!saved) throw new Error('No job receipt is selected.')\n    if (this.rejectedJob?.id === saved.receipt.id && !studioPointsPending(this.rejectedJob)) return this.rejectedJob\n    const reviewKey = this.reviewKey()\n    const response = await this.fetcher(`/api/studio/jobs/${saved.receipt.id}`, {\n      headers: { 'X-WORLDIFACT-Job': saved.receipt.ticket }, cache: 'no-store', signal: AbortSignal.timeout(STUDIO_POLL_TIMEOUT_MS),\n    })\n    try {\n      const job = parseStudioJob(await responseJson(response, saved.receipt.id, saved.fundingSource === PAID_POINTS_FUNDING), saved.receipt.id, saved.pricing?.points ?? Stop\n      // the endless timer and require same-job reconciliation; never POST again.\n      const ownershipMismatch = error instanceof StudioResponseError && error.status === 403 &&\n        error.message === 'This model belongs to a different account or has no account receipt.'\n      if (ownershipMismatch && this.saved?.receipt.id === saved.receipt.id && !this.submitting) {\n        const review: StudioJob = { id: saved.receipt.id, state: 'pending',\n          detail: 'This signed job receipt needs account-ledger reconciliation. Recovery is paused on the same job; no new generation or point charge is started.',\n          reconciliationRequired: true }\n        this.confirmedJob = review\n        return review\n      }\n      // These exact 401 responses reject the recovery credential itself. An\n      // expired login, another account, a timeout, 404 or 5xx is NOT equivalent.\n      const unusableReceipt = error instanceof StudioResponseError && error.status === 401 &&\n        ['The job receipt is not valid.', 'This job receipt expired. Its recovery record was preserved locally. The old model status is unknown; no model was deleted, cancelled or resubmitted. Your draft is kept. You can start a new model explicitly.' }\n      this.rejectedJob = rejected; this.confirmedJob = rejected\n      return rejected\n    }\n  }\n  async artifact(format: 'model' | 'pbr' | 'fbx' | 'blend', saved = this.saved): Promise<Blob> {\n    if (!saved) throw new Error('No job receipt is selected.')\n    const path = format === 'model' ? 'model' : `exports/${format}`\n    const response = await this.fetcher(`/api/studio/jobs/${saved.receipt.id}/${path}`, {\n      headers: { 'X-WORLDIFACT-Job': saved.receipt.ticket }, cache: 'no-store', signal: AbortSignal.timeout(180_000),\n    })\n    if (!response.ok) { await responseJson(response, saved.receipt.id, saved.fundingSource === PAID_POINTS_FUNDING); throw new Error('The artifact is unavailable.') }\n    const maximum = format === 'model' ? Retry this artifact, not generation.')\n    return new Blob(chunks, { type: format === 'model' ? 'model/gltf-binary' : format === 'pbr' ? 'application/zip' : 'application/octet-stream' })\n  }\n  clearSelection() {\n    if (this.submitting) throw new Error('Wait for submission to finish before changing jobs.')\n    if (this.saved) this.preserveReceipt(this.saved)\n    this.store.removeItem(STUDIO_RECEIPT_KEY); this.saved = null; this.confirmedJob = null; this.rejectedJob = null\n  }\n}\n","src/main.tsx":"import { StrictMode } from 'react'\nimport { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client'\nimport { BrowserRouter } from 'react-router-dom'\nimport App from './App'\nimport './index.css'\nimport './mobile-hotfix.css'\nimport { AccountProvider } from './lib/account'\nimport GenerationFundingPage from './pages/GenerationFundingPage'\nimport FailedHoldWaiverPage from './pages/FailedHoldWaiverPage'\n\n// Financial inspection must not mount normal account/billing recovery effects.\nconst readOnlyFunding = window.location.pathname === '/account/generation-funding'\nconst failedHoldWaiver = window.location.pathname === '/account/failed-hold-waiver'\n\ncreateRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render(\n  <StrictMode>\n    <BrowserRouter>\n      {readOnlyFunding ? Recovering the existing result costs no additional points.')) return\n    try { blueprintClient.current.reset(); setRecovery(null); setError('') }\n    catch (e) { setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Recovery could not be cleared.') }\n  }\n  const generate = async (event: React.FormEvent) => {\n    event.preventDefault()\n    // Output modes must never fall through to a different paid workflow.\n    if (creationModeRef.current !== 'model') return\n    const flags = operations.current, directClient = blueprintClient.current\n    if (cloudRecoveryPending || flags.status || flags.submit || flags.photos || flags.artifact || !previousFinished || !directClient) return\n    if (testSavedSlot || testBlueprintSlot) { setError('Recover and close the selected saved request before starting a new ordinary account generation.'); return }\n    if (otherSavedPending) { setOtherRecoveryError('Check the other saved requests before starting another generation.
